data.name: Ayanit
data.long_meaning: Ayanit is a Sanskrit name derived from the word 'Ayana' which means 'Sky'. This name is given to a boy born under the sky or in the sky. In Hindu mythology, Ayanit is the name of a celestial being, a god of the sky or the wind. He is depicted as a young boy, riding a chariot drawn by horses or eagles.

It is also associated with the gods of the sky and wind, and carrying such a name can lead to a strong connection and reverence for these deities.
